record_scope_reconstruction: Initial steel/ferrous rail-transit sanctions and a later observed cement train through Kena are separate phases. Neither passenger transit nor all cargo was generally blocked. Cement’s identified Kena post cannot automatically prove the steel phase’s complete gate roster.

source_checks.finding: Primary June 20 statement confirms steel/ferrous restrictions from June 17 and expressly says passenger and nonsanctioned transit continued; it supplies no specific rail-gate roster.
July 25 report describes LTG July 22 conditional authorization under EC guidance, not first steel passage.
July 26 early report explicitly identifies a five-wagon cement shipment still under checks at Kena.
Direct page 403; indexed later BNS report says cement train checked at Kena departed and describes an earlier first train. The first/second discrepancy remains.
Later operator network statement names alternative Russian and Belarusian rail interfaces; it cannot establish the exact 2022 steel-cargo restriction roster.
